scripts.check: mise exec -- sh -c 'lefthook validate && oxfmt --check && oxlint --deny-warnings && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run shell:check'
scripts.fix: mise exec -- sh -c 'oxfmt && bun run shell:fix'
scripts.shell:check: mise exec -- sh -c 'f=$(git ls-files -co --exclude-standard "*.sh") && shfmt -i 0 -ci -d $f && shellcheck -x $f'
scripts.dev: bun run dev:migrate && bun run --filter '*' dev
scripts.dev:ingest: bun run dev:migrate && bun --cwd=apps/ingest-worker run dev
scripts.dev:api: bun run dev:migrate && bun --cwd=apps/api-worker run dev
